FRONT_RULES:
# How to Play

## Your scores

Roll one die and add 6: that is your **Nerve**. Roll two dice and add 12: your **Vigour**. Roll one die and add 6: your **Fortune**. Or play in Story Mode: Nerve 9, Vigour 20, Fortune 9, and choose the outcome of every test.

## Fear

Fear starts at 0 and can never fall below 0. If it reaches your Nerve + 3, turn to the section given here.

## Doom

[The book's countdown track. What raises it, what it means at each value, and where it sends you at 5.]

## Tests and fights

To test your Nerve, roll two dice: equal to or under your Nerve is a success. To test your Fortune, do the same against Fortune, then lose 1 Fortune.

## Checkpoints and death

Sections marked with ✈ are checkpoints. Write the number of the last one you passed. If you die, the section tells you where to go back to.

## Codewords and items

Write them on your Adventure Sheet when the book tells you to, and cross them off when it says so.
